headline: Santosh Ratanlal Kataria HUF files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Santosh Ratanlal Kataria HUF has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in D. P. Abhushan Limited. The disclosure triggers public transparency obligations on acquisition of 5% or more of voting shares.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure of acquisitions crossing specified thresholds. The HUF's submission to NSE initiates the regulated disclosure cascade. No acquisition value, share count, or final timeline is disclosed in the Bar & Bench extract; the actual shareholding percentage and consideration must be verified from the full NSE filing. Subsequent steps will likely include an open-offer notice (if threshold requires it) and company board acknowledgement.
